name: Untap cost — firing a {Q} ability untaps its source; removing the ability taps it again
notes: Conor, 2026-11-26: the {Q} cost (the untap symbol) untaps the source as the ability is fired, as {T} taps it. Safehold Sentry, tapped, is untapped by its own ability and gets +0/+2. Puresight Merrow, tapped, is untapped by firing and tapped again when the fired ability is removed.
